rationales: Necrosis is accidental, uncontrolled cell death.
Apoptosis is programmed cell death.
Blebs are cell-membrane bulges, not a type of cell death.
Metastasis is the spread of cancer cells to other parts of the body.
Substrates are the molecules on which enzymes act.
Products are formed by enzyme-catalysed reactions.
Cofactors assist some enzymes but are not the molecules acted upon.
Coenzymes assist enzymes but are not the molecules acted upon.
Ribose does not have three carbon atoms.
Ribose does not have four carbon atoms.
Ribose is a pentose sugar with five carbon atoms.
Ribose does not have six carbon atoms.
Villi are not found in the stomach.
Villi are not found in the oesophagus.
Villi line the small intestine and increase its absorptive surface area.
The large intestine does not have the villi characteristic of the small intestine.
Platelets help form blood clots.
Erythrocytes mainly transport oxygen and do not cause clotting.
Neutrophils are white blood cells involved in defence against infection.
Basophils are white blood cells involved in inflammatory responses.
Taxonomy is the science of classifying organisms.
Physiology studies the functions of living organisms.
Entomology is the study of insects.
Biotechnology uses organisms or biological processes to develop products and techniques.
Glucose is a small molecule and is an example of a micromolecule.
Starch is a large polysaccharide, so it is a macromolecule.
Proteins are macromolecules made of amino acids.
Lipids are generally classified as macromolecules in this context.
Ronald Ross later demonstrated the role of mosquitoes in malaria transmission.
A. F. A. King proposed that mosquitoes transmitted malaria.
Laveran was the French army physician who began investigating malaria in 1878.
Mendel is known for foundational work in genetics, not malaria research.
An order contains related families, not the nearest genera.
A phylum is a broader taxonomic group than a family.
A class is a broad group containing related orders.
A family is a group of closely related genera.
Protein is not the characteristic structural material of fungal cell walls.
Chitin is a major structural component of fungal cell walls.
Fat is not the characteristic structural material of fungal cell walls.
Cellulose is characteristic of plant cell walls, not fungal cell walls.
Stroma is the fluid-filled region surrounding the thylakoids.
Cristae are folds of the inner mitochondrial membrane.
A granum is a stack of thylakoids.
A chloroplast is the organelle that contains thylakoids, not a stack of them.
Mitosis normally produces two daughter cells.
Four daughter cells are typically produced by meiosis, not mitosis.
Mitosis does not normally produce six daughter cells.
Mitosis does not normally produce eight daughter cells.
Meiosis produces gametes and is not the usual process whose errors produce tumors.
Errors in mitosis can cause uncontrolled cell division and tumor formation.
Binary fission is a form of cell division in prokaryotes, not the usual cause described here.
Multiple fission is not the process associated with tumor formation in this context.
Amylase acts on starch and other carbohydrates.
Pepsin digests proteins.
Lipase acts on lipids.
Proteases act on proteins.
Reduction is the gain of electrons.
Hydration is the addition of water.
Oxidation is the loss of electrons.
Electrolysis uses an electric current to drive a chemical change.
